about: A tool that clones or backs up all the repos of an organization or user in one go.

prs.title: Pruning a Gitea backup no longer deletes every clone
prs.broken: With Gitea, the prune option thought every local copy was gone from the server and deleted all of them, so each scheduled run wiped the whole backup.
prs.changed: Local copies are now matched to server repos by name too, so only repos really removed on the server are pruned.
prs.matters: Backups stay in place, and local work in those folders is not lost.
